chunks: And Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from him that he said:
"If you leave Mina before sunset, then do not let the morning come upon you except while you are there."

key_terms.غُرُوبِ: sunset, the setting of the sun
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the sacred site associated with the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about leaving Mina before sunset during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction related to the rites of hajj and the obligation of remaining connected to Mina during the prescribed period. It indicates that if one departs Mina before sunset, one must still be in Mina by morning.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3009 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) that he said:
"If you leave Mina before sunset, then do not let the morning come upon you except while you are still in Mina."
